items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Yeah, Don used to play with us quite often.

ctx.x: G-E-R-O-U-L-D. You say that Art Hody sat in with you. If I remember, Don Ewell used to occasionally.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yeah, Don used to play with us quite often. In fact, I think we may have made some records which have become lost.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Well, we'll try to find them. We talked about the styles that you were emulating. It seems to me that the trombone might also.
